scope: Presentation-only removal after the public Run Out of Town event, named Run Out of Town.
interpretation: After the public Run Out of Town effect removes its chosen crew member, the existing approved walking clip depicts a withdrawal instead of a fatal fall. The public destroy log and discard destination remain canonical. This is a fictional game action, not a claim that an identified person was historically expelled or that dynamite was a documented expulsion practice. No new appearance, equipment or historical biography is introduced.
privacy: Select the scene from the public event-resolution log, including when the later target choice arrives after the event prop has gone. Face-down people retain the generic Drifter appearance. Do not inspect private hands.
validation_required: Walking displacement without ragdoll or hit effects
Legal-action replay and canonical mechanics preservation
